entries.en: Am I supposed to know who you are?
entries.ro: Ar trebui să știu cine ești?

entries.en: Hey, you, been a long time!
entries.ro: Hei, tu, a trecut mult timp!

entries.en: Do you like it there…? No? Really? Ha, ha… The highway, huh…
entries.ro: Îți place acolo...? Nu? Serios? Ha, ha... Autostrada, huh...

entries.en: I'd love to… you know I can't… When…? Oh…! So soon! OK, I'm waiting!
entries.ro: Mi-ar plăcea... știi că nu pot... Când...? Oh...! Așa repede! OK, aștept!

entries.en: Anyone got a gun? Right now!
I was supposed to see my daughter...
entries.ro: Ar fi trebuit să-mi văd fiica...

entries.en: You wanna fuck off by yourself, or should I help you?
entries.ro: Vrei să te cari singură, pula mea, sau te ajut eu?
entries.ro_m: Vrei să te cari singur, pula mea, sau te ajut eu?

entries.en: I thought you wanted to talk...
We had a convo goin', did we not?
